entries.speaker: Worried Female Student
entries.en: I'm so traumatized from the video[n]of that accident. I've been afraid[n]of riding the train ever since.

entries.speaker: Talkative Female Student
entries.en: There've been similar accidents before,[n]right? What happens if you get a psychotic[n]breakdown?

entries.speaker: Worried Female Student
entries.en: Well, out of nowhere, you go crazy and[n]violent, and then you suddenly pass out.

entries.speaker: Worried Female Student
entries.en: In the very end, you die in a lot of pain.[n]That's what I hear. You die, or you're as[n]good as dead.

entries.speaker: Talkative Female Student
entries.en: Oh my gosh, that's too freaky. I don't want[n]to die in some weird accident or a psychotic[n]breakdown.

entries.speaker: Worried Female Student
entries.en: And no one knows what's causing it.[n]At this point, even a curse or magic[n]would make sense...

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: Man, she even looks hot in a jersey...[n]I wonder if I have a shot with her...

entries.speaker: Sleepy Student
entries.en: You really want Kamoshida's leftovers?[n]I like the girl with the ponytail better...

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: Oh, you mean from the volleyball team?[n]I guess I kinda get you...

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: There's also a really cute first-year with a[n]ponytail though. Why not her?

entries.speaker: Sleepy Student
entries.en: Wait, there was a girl like that!?[n]I didn't look at all...

entries.speaker: Sleepy Student
entries.en: So, which team is that first-year on?[n]Don't tell me it's volleyball...

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: No clue. But she'd be in trouble if it was.

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: Everyone on the team's always hurt, and[n]some even have bruises on their faces...

entries.speaker: Sleepy Student
entries.en: You're talkin' about the ponytail girl, right?[n]Yeah, I feel so bad for her...

entries.speaker: Sleepy Student
entries.en: Takamaki should speak up about that...

entries.speaker: Boorish Student
entries.en: She probably only cares about herself.[n]She's sitting pretty as Kamoshida's girl,[n]you know...
